heroHeadline: Kirishi Strike and Euro-2 Fuel Decree Mark Deepest Point Yet of Russia's Second Shortage Wave
heroSubtitle: A drone strike sparks fire at Russia's second-largest refinery, Kirishi (KINEF), just as it prepared to resume output, while Moscow expands its downgraded-fuel decree to Euro-2 and Euro-4 grades through mid-2027 to stretch a gasoline supply already running ~70% of demand
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
